messages:
alexa: FYI — I see a sustained P95 jump on /v1/generate starting ~11:36 UTC. Token-level waterfall shows two clusters: early tokens (~2-5) and tail tokens (>40). Heatmap → https://redwood.internal/dashboards/token-latency?route=/v1/generate

mike: Any recent rollout or model change?

alexa: No model or quant rollout. No API gateway change. Perf alert triggered by perf-bot.

perf-bot: perf alert (AUTO): route=/v1/generate P95_token_latency +38% vs baseline; window=30m; traces=87; sample=trace-b2c3

dana: Could be KV-cache pressure or kernel selector oscillating for certain seq_len distribution. Do we have cache hit ratios for that window?

sarah: We emit kv_cache_hit_rate at the aggregate level, but we don't attach selected_kernel to spans right now. That makes trace->metric correlation hard.

mike: If kernel selection flips between gpu_fmha and cutlass kernels mid-sequence, token latency will spike on the switch. Also smaller batches increase prefix diversity -> worse cache reuse.

alexa: Pulled a quick profiler from a sample node (trimmed):
```
profile_window: 11:30-11:40
model: redwood-7b-quant
avg_seq_len: 68
avg_batch_size: 3.1
kernel_switches_per_trace: 3.2
median_token_ms: 7.1
p95_token_ms: 22.8
kv_cache_hit_rate: 39%
```

dana: 39% hit rate is low. Did the batching heuristic change recently?

sarah: We merged a tweak to dynamic-batching last week: batch_window_ms reduced 14->7 to meet latency SLOs. That lowers batching and could increase unique prefixes.

mike: That matches. Fewer requests per batch => less KV reuse => more misses => more compute per token and potentially different kernel choices.

alexa: Proposal: enrich per-request telemetry and traces so we can pivot easily:
- Add span attributes: selected_kernel, kv_cache_hit (boolean), kv_cache_hit_ratio, batch_size, batch_window_ms, batch_origin (dynamic|static)
- Emit token_latency_breakdown (comma list) as metric for a request
- Include trace_id tag on metric points so dashboards can drill into traces

perf-bot: +1. This will also help automated regression detection. Need ingestion changes for token-level arrays.

sarah: I'll open a PR to add span attrs + metrics in runtime: include tests for deterministic kernel tie-breaker. Plan: instrument, update metrics schema, and add waterfall dashboard widget.

dana: Also request a 10% traffic canary that reverts batch_window_ms to 14ms for /v1/generate so we can measure KV hit impact. Keep it on dedicated-canary nodes.

mike: I'll create a canary routing rule and capture 2k traces over 24h. I'll also snapshot kernel-selection logs. Can we enable debug-only runtime.kv.dump_keys on canary nodes (keys only, redacted)?

alexa: Yes — enable debug flag runtime.kv.dump_keys=true for the canary set only. Ensure PII redaction is enforced.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/revert-batch-window -> nodeset=dedicated-canary-3; ETA=18m; CI checks pending.

perf-bot: Reminder: add dashboard cards per-route: median/p95 token latency, avg KV hit ratio, percent traces with kernel_switches>1.

sarah: Will also add a per-request trace link on the per-route KPI card (click-through to full trace). That requires trace_id on metrics — adding now.

mike: I'll attach the baseline trace bundle (1000 traces) to the issue once collected and tag @eng-sre for log access.

alexa: Great. Target to run canary for 24h and reconvene with numbers tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Thanks! :thumbsup:
